data.title: Expose common work, ownership, follow-up and evidence in the dashboard
data.description: Plan and implement the TypeScript dashboard consumer after common-work contracts are published; coordinate with the existing dashboard owner before editing shared UI. Done: users can inspect open/waiting/blocked/overdue work and pending approvals, see outcome, accountable owner, steps, next review and completion evidence, and submit supported owner/evidence actions through validated APIs. Refresh authoritative state after reconnect; distinguish action execution from verified outcome completion. Preserve existing approval and simulation behavior.
